description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git rebase operations, specifically testing the '--onto' feature with revisions involving multiple commits and branches, along with other rebase options. The script sets up various commit and branch scenarios and verifies the behavior of Git rebase commands under different conditions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a specified label or content as part of test setup.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test environment's internal clock.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test section expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that is expected to fail, verifying the failure.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual files or outputs.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares the revision history or commits of two references.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor environment for testing interactive rebase.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies that the editor environment remains unchanged during tests.
